h: FCCPC updates its list of approved loan apps, highlighting five platforms for salary earners
p: Nigeria's consumer protection regulator has refreshed its list of loan apps, highlighting five platforms said to offer salary earners as much as N10 million. The update is meant to help borrowers pick registered lenders rather than unlicensed ones.
more: Borrowers are urged to check that an app is on the official list before sharing personal data.
Unregistered loan apps have faced complaints over harassment and hidden charges.
